signal: Exact-main production was READY and affected route readback passed, but the click-driven NL→EN production canary timed out waiting for /en/prijzen.
root_cause: The public language-option handler persisted locale state but deliberately left navigation to the browser's default anchor behavior. In the mobile navigation surface, other delegated menu handlers can tear down/close the menu during the same click, so default navigation was not a deterministic transition owner.
fix: Intercept every supported language-option click and route it through the canonical setLocale(target) owner. Public setLocale explicitly performs location.assign(localizedHref(target)); portal behavior remains in-place translation. Semantic hrefs remain for no-JS/SEO.

evidence.failed_step: Verify pricing interactions and English route in production

prevention: One executable owner for language-option navigation.
Never depend on default anchor navigation after a delegated mobile-menu click.
Retain real hrefs for semantics/no-JS while JS uses explicit locale transition ownership.
Production closure requires real-control click NL→EN→NL readback.
